228	    seed = require_range(document["seed"], 0, 2 ** 64 - 1, "seed")
229	    low_count = require_range(document["low_count"], 1, 32, "low_count")
230	    attempts = require_range(document["attempts"], 1, 3, "attempts")
231	    spacing_ms = require_range(document["spacing_ms"], 1, 1000, "spacing_ms")
232	    timeout_ms = require_range(document["timeout_ms"], 1, 1000000,
233	                               "timeout_ms")
234	
235	    raw_windows = document["windows"]
236	    if type(raw_windows) is not list:
237	        raise UserError("windows must be an array")
238	    if len(raw_windows) > MAX_WINDOWS:
239	        raise UserError("too many windows")
240	
241	    windows = []
242	    seen_windows = set()
243	    total_selected = 0
244	    for entry in raw_windows:
245	        require_object(entry, WINDOW_KEYS, "window")
246	        ident = require_id(entry["id"], "window id")
247	        if ident in seen_windows:
248	            raise UserError("duplicate window id %r" % ident)
249	        seen_windows.add(ident)
250	        start_ms = require_range(entry["start_ms"], 0, 10 ** 12, "start_ms")
251	        raw_scopes = entry["scopes"]
252	        if type(raw_scopes) is not list:
253	            raise UserError("scopes must be an array")
254	        if len(raw_scopes) > MAX_SCOPES:
255	            raise UserError("too many scopes in one window")
256	
257	        scopes = []
258	        seen_scopes = set()
259	        seen_networks = set()
260	        for item in raw_scopes:
261	            require_object(item, SCOPE_KEYS, "scope")
262	            scope_id = require_id(item["id"], "scope id")
263	            if scope_id in seen_scopes:
264	                raise UserError("duplicate scope id %r in window" % scope_id)
265	            seen_scopes.add(scope_id)
266	            prefixlen, base = parse_prefix(item["prefix"])
267	            raw_subnets = item["subnets"]
268	            if type(raw_subnets) is not list:
269	                raise UserError("subnets must be an array")
270	            if prefixlen == 64:
271	                if not (len(raw_subnets) == 1
272	                        and type(raw_subnets[0]) is int
273	                        and raw_subnets[0] == 0):
274	                    raise UserError("a /64 prefix requires subnets [0]")
275	                subnets = [0]
276	            else:
277	                if not raw_subnets or len(raw_subnets) > 256:
278	                    raise UserError("subnets must hold 1-256 values")
279	                distinct = set()
280	                for value in raw_subnets:
281	                    require_int(value, "subnet number")
282	                    if not 0 <= value <= 255:
283	                        raise UserError("subnet number out of range")
284	                    if value in distinct:
285	                        raise UserError("duplicate subnet number")
286	                    distinct.add(value)
287	                subnets = sorted(distinct)
288	            scopes.append(Scope(scope_id, prefixlen, base, subnets))
289	
290	        # Selected /64 networks may not overlap inside one window.
291	        window_networks = 0
292	        for scope in scopes:
293	            if scope.prefixlen == 56:
294	                for subnet in scope.subnets:
295	                    network = scope.base + (subnet << 64)
296	                    if network not in seen_networks:
297	                        seen_networks.add(network)
298	                        window_networks += 1
299	            else:
300	                if scope.base not in seen_networks:
301	                    seen_networks.add(scope.base)
302	                    window_networks += 1
303	
304	        total_selected += window_networks
305	        if total_selected > MAX_SELECTED:
306	            raise UserError("too many selected /64 networks")
307	        windows.append(Window(ident, start_ms, scopes))
308	
309	    windows.sort(key=lambda item: item.id)
310	    for window in windows:
311	        window.scopes.sort(key=lambda item: item.id)
312	    return Manifest(seed, low_count, attempts, spacing_ms, timeout_ms,
313	                    windows)
